title: `remix/component` runtime renders non-HTML responses as a document when a link points to a file
author: sergiodxa
body_preview: ### Summary  After `run()` boots, the runtime intercepts every same-origin `<a>` click through the Navigation API and resolves it as a frame. When the link points to a file (an image, a PDF, a `.txt`/`.xml`/`.json`/`.md` endpoint), the response body is rendered into the page as if it were HTML. author: ekomzo

title: Starter template and docs layout cost agents extra turns and tokens
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: ## Summary  We measured coding agents building small features in a fresh `remix new` app (`remix@3.3.0`). Every run produced a working feature, so correctness isn't the problem.
